soundness_flags.one_line: The pointwise ADRF and band endpoints use density and conditional-expectation versions at every a, but the core never declares the canonical continuous Sobolev representatives needed to make these values invariant rather than only a.e. defined.

The paper constructs asymptotically valid uniform confidence bands for nonparametric EIV regression with an unknown error distribution using validation data or repeated measurements.

Correct the HuangZhang2023 bibliography locator to the journal's actual pp. 474--496 and add exact page/theorem anchors for each load-bearing comparator, especially the Capitao-Miniconi--Gassiat--Lehericy compact-support rate result.

Add a short theorem-level transfer statement isolating why recovery of q_x is not merely a formal consequence of latent-law identification: specify the local observable ratio, analytic continuation of the signed compactly supported measure, and the denominator-stability step for the ADRF.
